statement: Every corporation that is incorporated, registered, or doing business in California must pay the $800 minimum franchise tax, due the first quarter of each accounting period and owed whether the corporation is active, inactive, or operating at a loss; newly incorporated or qualified corporations are not required to pay the minimum franchise tax in their first year, and the corporate income/franchise rate above the minimum is 8.84%.
caveat: The first-year exemption and the 15-day/no-business short-year exception have precise conditions, banks and financial corporations use different rates, and amounts change by legislation — verify against the live FTB page and Revenue and Taxation Code § 23153 before relying. This repo does not compute the tax.
